source: flipcash2-server 85aec15, messaging/boost.go and intent/chat.go; flipcash2-client-protocol 0.20.0, proto/intent/v1/model.proto:70-107 (ReactionBoost)
note: Pick the intent and per-share fiat for a reaction boost. payer is creator, member, or sender (the person who sent the message, i.e. a self-boost); messageSender is creator or member. Amounts are USD decimal strings. creator = round_half_even(total * creatorPercent / 100) to the cent, sender = total - creator. The server accepts either rounding direction within half a cent, so half-even is a client-parity choice; at 20% no whole-cent total produces a tie. Multi-payment payees are listed sender then creator, the order multi_payment_intent.json's 'boost 80/20' uses; the server accepts either order. Quarks are omitted on purpose: each share's quarks are computed from that share's own fiat at the shared verified rate and reserve state (curve.json / curve_fractional.json gate that conversion), never as a split of the whole's quarks. expectedError names the rule, not a platform error type.
